correctness.rationale: For odd y, factor y+5=2^j k with k odd, so the next odd term is ky. Any k>1 strictly increases odd states. Solving 2^j(k^2-2^{2h})=5(k-1) for a first entry to terminal 2^m-5 forces k=3,j=h=1 and initial y=1. Subsequent dyadic multiplication gives exact B(X) and logarithmic-squared asymptotic.
